name: Lat-Nam
description: Isle to which the War Beasts teleport and where the artifact beasts are destroyed.

description_citations.text: "The Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves leads an expedition to Lat-Nam, fights the guardians, then befriends them and begins excavating.
timeline.quote: she managed to befriend the guardians and began excavating the ruins

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and Karli lead a surprise attack on her camp; Haakon fireballs Gull.
timeline.quote: Haakon unleashed a fireball at Gull, seemingly killing him

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves kills Haakon and traps the remaining enemy wizards in the poisoned desert.
timeline.quote: killing Haakon and trapping the remaining enemy wizards in the poisoned desert

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves ascends to a godlike state until Kwam reveals her brothers survived.
timeline.quote: This revelation snapped her back to her senses.

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves channels all her mana into the land, transforming it into a paradise and surrendering her planeswalker powers.
timeline.quote: she surrendered her planeswalker powers, returning to a mortal existence

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves is declared High Wizard of the Domains as the remaining wizards submit.
timeline.quote: She was declared the High Wizard of the Domains by her followers

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl found the college to codify magic, understand Thran artifacts and stop the brothers.
timeline.quote: The College of Lat-Nam was founded by Drafna and Hurkyl

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sages create the Stone Brain, which is launched into space instead of being destroyed.
timeline.quote: was instead launched into space

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers destroy the college and many of its sages.
timeline.quote: the school itself was destroyed by the Brothers at some point during the war

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The College of Lat-Nam is destroyed in the Fall of the College of Lat-Nam and the land is poisoned.
timeline.quote: The college was destroyed in the Fall of the College of Lat-Nam and the land was poisoned

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "College of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sages of Lat-Nam build the Stone Brain; they fight over it, then enclose it in a box and launch it into space.
timeline.quote: the sages enclosed it in a box and launched it into space

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves dons the helmet and learns its ultimate secret lies in the ruins of Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: She donned the helmet

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic; Gull lets the others keep magic only for good; Greensleeves keeps the last secret to herself.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves used the Stone Brain to strip Towser of his magic

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl study the machines on Lat-Nam, keeping many discoveries secret until after their deaths.
timeline.quote: Although their separatist views kept many of their discoveries secret until after their death

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Soldevi Steam Beasts attack and destroy the School, leaving Lat-Nam without a school of magic; survivors travel to the Institute of Arcane Study.
timeline.quote: the school was attacked by Soldevi Steam Beasts and destroyed.

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "School of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The school is forced to relocate at the start of the Ice Age and settles on newly risen land.
timeline.quote: the scholars settled on new land risen from the sea, south and west from the original island of Lat-Nam.

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerda and Ozmar leave Lat-Nam for good; Jodah grants Gerda the position of Archmage of the Unseen.
timeline.quote: she was legally granted the position of Archmage of the Unseen by Jodah

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerda Äagesdotter says Lat-Nam's knowledge could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: "All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."

citation.text: Lat-Nam's Legacy (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The School of the Unseen hides after retribution on Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: After the terrible retribution visited upon Lat-Nam, this school of mages chose to hide from the eyes of the world.

citation.text: School of the Unseen (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The party teleports to Lat-Nam, is attacked by Duler angels and Copper Conch merfolk, and Greensleeves befriends them.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves communicates with the angels and the merfolk, who had been tasked by the Sages to be guardians of Lat-Nam, and befriends them.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves to the underwater College, where she asks a Sage's skull the secret of the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves finds a skull of a Sage, to which she asks the secret of the Stone Brain.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and the wizards attack the army; the army retreats into the tunnel where Gull has a prophetic dream and realizes the warlord's identity.
timeline.quote: he doesn't see Sparrow Hawk , his long-lost brother, and has a revelation about the warlord's identity.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull reveals to the warlord that he is Sparrow Hawk, kidnapped and enchanted by Towser, and the brothers reconcile; Haakon engulfs them in a fireball.
timeline.quote: the two brothers reconcile. However, Haakon unleashes a fireball against the two, which are engulfed in flames.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves goes mad with anger and sorrow, blasts Haakon, traps the other wizards, summons a Force of Nature and absorbs its mana to become god-like.
timeline.quote: She blasts Haakon with a bolt, then traps the other wizards in the desert and summons a Force of Nature .

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brought to her senses by Kwam, Greensleeves pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing the land and sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
timeline.quote: thus sacrificing her planeswalker powers.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic with the Stone Brain; Gull lets other wizards keep magic only to do good; the wizards pledge obedience and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: who is declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves learns the Stone Brain's ultimate secret lies in the ruins of the College of Lat-Nam, and the army teleports there; Chaney's shade passes on.
timeline.quote: The party teleported to Lat-Nam

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After battle, Greensleeves parleys with the Duler Angels and the merfolk guardians and they help excavate the ruins.
timeline.quote: Befriending them by explaining the common goal, the rest of the army was summoned to the ruins, and excavation was started.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves underwater where she asks a Sage's skull for the Stone Brain's secret.
timeline.quote: She mentally asked the skull for the secret of the Stone Brain.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and the other wizards attack; Gull's prophetic dream reveals the Keldon warlord is his brother.
timeline.quote: this made him realize what the warlord's identity was

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull reveals to the warlord that he is Sparrow Hawk, and the brothers reconcile.
timeline.quote: the two brothers reconciled

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers; Greensleeves, mad with grief, makes her final sacrifice, destroying the wizards' magic, and becomes godlike.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves became a godlike being and briefly lost herself completely

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kwam brings Greensleeves to her senses; she pours her mana into Lat-Nam, healing the land, and loses her spark.
timeline.quote: This outpouring of mana caused Greensleeves to lose her spark.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "High Wizard of the Domains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic with the Stone Brain; the other wizards keep theirs to do good and pledge obedience, and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: who was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "High Wizard of the Domains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Lat-Nam Gull realizes the warlord is his lost brother Sparrow Hawk and the brothers reconcile.
timeline.quote: the two brothers reconciled

citation.text: "Gull", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers; Greensleeves goes mad, becomes godlike, but is calmed by Kwam and pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing it and sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
timeline.quote: thus sacrificing her planeswalker powers

citation.text: "Gull", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

citation.text: "Gull", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull reveals the warlord is his brother Sparrow Hawk; Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers and Greensleeves, maddened, becomes a godlike being.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves became a godlike being and lost herself

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kwam brings Greensleeves to her senses and she pours her mana into Lat-Nam, healing it and losing her spark.
timeline.quote: This outpouring of mana caused Greensleeves to lose her spark.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic, the other wizards are allowed to keep theirs for good, and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves, who was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerda says Lat-Nam's sages could not be protected from the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War.

citation.text: Lat-Nam's Legacy (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and her party come to Lat-Nam in 4077 AR to uncover the secrets of the Stone Brain, battling and befriending its guardians.
timeline.quote: After a battle, Greensleeves befriended the guardians and led an excavation

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves kills Haakon after he hits her brother, traps the wizards and absorbs a Force of Nature, nearly losing herself until Kwam restores her sanity.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves, in a fit of grief and rage, killed Haakon

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves pours her mana into Lat-Nam, purging its corruption and turning it into a paradise at the cost of her planeswalker powers; she becomes High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: This act cost her planeswalker powers , but secured her victory

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone Dihada disposes of the Tolarian Academy's archmage, and Ertai and the Society of Mishra later turn it into a haven for dark research.
timeline.quote: Geyadrone Dihada disposed of the Academy's archmage and took his place.
